text:
Upgrade Order - Melee 
​
Introduction & Disclaimer
This channel lists the recommended general melee purchase/unlock progression for players to follow.
​
Last Revised: 23rd October 2026
The order is subject to change at any time as prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands
​
Please note the following assumptions:
⬥ The order assume a starting point of T70 gear  
⬥ Priorities may be different if you are doing niche content
⬥ "ROI" (meaning return-on-investment) typically means quality-of-life upgrades or typical damage increase
⬥ We do not recommend selling an item to buy another, unless it is a direct upgrade
⬥ Unlisted items are not worth buying
​
Feel free to ask in #pvm-help for a tailored list to the content that you do!
​
Melee Upgrade Order
For further information on each upgrade, check #armour-and-weapons, #perks and #perk-information, #permanent-unlocks, or #eof-specs
​
Stage 1: High ROI
⬥ Work towards everything in #unknown-channel
⬥ Laniakea's Spear  -  3,984,192
⬥ Am-hej  -  3,455,617
⬥ Abyssal Scourge  + Dark Ice Sliver  -  62,799,647
⬥ 1st god book (Scripture of Jas  or Amascut )
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎•  -  2,651,716
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎•  -  1,837,525
⬥ Jaws of the Abyss  + Laceration Boots  -  1,164,951
⬥ Precise 6  + Eruptive 4  on weapons -  1,929,871
⬥ Equilibrium 1  + Mobile X  on armour -  585,679
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Choose X based on your preferred content (e.g., Demon slayer  / Venomblood  / Dragon slayer  / Genocidal )
⬥ Greater Barge  -  140,391,485
⬥ Greater Flurry  -  105,122,602
⬥ Igneous Kal-Ket  -  free!
⬥ Crackling 4  + Ultimatums 4  on armour -  13,375,765
⬥ Flanking 4  on cheap offhand (if doing applicable content) -  5,485,374
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• E.g., Off-hand ripper claw  -  479,865
⬥ Vestments of Havoc Boots + Hood   -  185,505,880
⬥ Vestments of Havoc Bottom  -  256,964,093
⬥ Cinderbanes (if doing poisonable content)  -  41,840,261
​
Stage 2: Medium ROI
⬥ All other upgrades in #unknown-channel
⬥ Masterwork 2h sword  -  238,210,409
⬥ Chaos Roar  -  138,862,804
⬥ Vestment of Havoc Top  -  359,817,810
⬥ Scripture of Ful  -  117,112,599
⬥ Divert  -  21,108,350
⬥ Ek-ZekKil  -  2,059,663,370
⬥ Dragon Claws EoF    -  166,289,662 +  2,097,966
⬥ Biting build 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Biting 4  -  80,259,191
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Champion's Ring  -  6,675,054
⬥ Equilibrium build 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equilibrium 4  -  171,511,345
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Masterwork Spear of Annihilation  + Lunging 4  -  264,267,882
⬥ Both builds
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enhanced Gloves of Passage  -  75,579,696
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Impatient 4  + Devoted 4  on armour -  57,783,085
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Aftershock 4  on weapon
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Cheapest: combo'd with Precise 2   -  30,386,167
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Least waste: combo'd with Eruptive 2   -  52,863,814
​
Stage 3: Low ROI
⬥ Dark Sliver of Leng  + Dark Shard of Leng  -  498,356,458 +  531,242,276
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Higher priority if you are primarily speed-killing
⬥ Shard of Genesis Essence  -  586,493,097
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use on EZK 
⬥ Upgrade prayers depending on content:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Malevolence  -  618,835,671
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Eclipsed Soul  + Divine Rage  -  75,220,620
⬥ Greater Fury  -  381,307,292
⬥ P6R1   + AS4E2   for 2H weapons -  80,686,501
⬥ P6AS1   + AS4E2   for dual-wield weapons -  111,477,785
⬥ Enchantment of Agony  -  72,742,469
⬥ Shard of Genesis Essence  -  586,493,097
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use on  
⬥ Nodon spike harness  -  410,612,661
⬥ Vital Drain  -  182,637,671
⬥ Limitless  -  126,980,000
⬥ Varanus' Mercy EoF   -  166,289,662 +  201,623,832
⬥ Enchantment of Heroism ( upgrade) -  67,068,689
​
